source_document: Plan Hidrológico del Guadalquivir 2022–2027, Normativa, Apéndice 7.7.1 (Sistema 7 Regulación General, subsistema Regulación General: principales tomas), Real Decreto 35/2023, BOE-A-2023-3511
notes: The plan lists the reservoirs of the Regulación General subsystem as its main intakes (plus the Guadalquivir from the reservoirs to its mouth) and assigns Linares, La Carolina-Vilches, Córdoba Sur, Lora del Río and others to it without naming which reservoir serves each. All 19 are listed; the town-level intake is not known.
